doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: Visiting New Orleans bands and slipping out to dances
summary: New Orleans bands came to Pensacola; Billie and a sister sneaked out to dances while their father slept, with Sadie playing.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Did any bands come from out of town there?
What bands would those be? Do you remember?

Well... Celestand... Celestand... Buddy PT... Yeah. Yeah. And... Celestand... From out of New Orleans... And let me see who is... Who is? Huh? Renee. What about Renee then? Renee used to come there. Oh. Yeah. Well... Well... Renee... I mean... New Orleans bands... That's all them old ones. Yeah. Did you all of them... All of them came... Kid Point. Yeah. They all used to be over there in Punta Cora playing. And Bebe Chinese. Maybe he's a drummer.
I know him. His name is Abby Foster.

Yeah. That's my brother-in-law. That's my... That's right. That's my sister Sadie... My husband. Yeah. Sadie and Chinese... We worked together... You know... When they was together. Celestand. Celestand, see?
These girls managed to get married off to musicians. He's done. Now... Did you sit in with any of those bands when they came over there?

Well... I was quite young then, at times... I used to slip out and go. See? I used to slip out and go because my daddy wouldn't let me and my other sister hadn't been going. We would steal away and go, you see? Slip out. Papa would go to bed. Papa would go to bed. Me and I hadn't been gone. We slipped out and gone to the dance. You were still a martyr. Yeah, we still a martyr. And Sadie would be playing those dances. Lots of my older sister Sadie. She would be playing them dances. Sadie would see me. I'd be done stick out her head in the hole like that. She looked. She wouldn't say nothing. You understand? She just kept on during her way. She said, wait till you get on. Papa will fix you all. Then Ed and I would have slipped inside. Sneaked in the wind. Then the way would get him and he'd sneak in. Go to the dance.
